title: CDS Trading Initiation, Information Asymmetry, and Dividend Payout
near_miss_reason: Every reported column (Table 3 columns 1-4, Tables 5-7, Figure 1 event study) includes nine time-varying firm controls including the lagged dependent variable l_dps; no controls-free TWFE is reported. Table 3 column 3 additionally uses overlap (propensity) weights and column 2 a matched sample; Table 4 is a three-step IV; Table 6 uses xtivreg2.
eligible_reason: Design qualifies: firm-year panel 1990-2014 (6,713 firms) with traded_post = 1 from the year of CDS trading initiation onward (14 cohorts, 2000-2014; 606 switchers; 6,081 never-treated; no switch-off), firm FE and year FE, cluster by firm. But all columns add time-varying controls and a lagged outcome, so the paper is a near-miss.
design_notes: all_stata_program_14DEC2021.do: Table 3 col 1: areg dps traded_post size mb roa asset_growth sales_growth std_ret age lev l_dps _Ifyear_*, absorb(gvkey1) cluster(gvkey1) on test_full_sample.dta; col 2 matched sample (test.dta); col 3 overlap weights [pweight=weight]; col 4 and Figure 1 on test_full6.dta with event-time dummies last_cds_intition_3..post_cds_intition_3. Table 4: probit first stage with lender FX hedging instrument then areg. Table 5: CDS liquidity splits. Table 6: leverage controls / xtivreg2. Table 7: heterogeneity splits (FCF, financial constraints, bank reputation, covenants). Table 1 in SAS.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls including lagged dependent variable in every column
